text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The time has come to fill out the entry 
forms for the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe. 
The Trainer and Nakayama Festa firmly 
believed that they had done everything 
humanly possible.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa insists, however, that she 
needs one more year to win the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe. ...Precisely because 
she wants to win it without fail.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her former teacher didn't have much time 
left. She knew that. That's why, even 
knowing she lacked the strength, even 
knowing she might lose—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—"But is it right to say 'losing can't be 
helped' and lay the blame of defeat on 
your mentor?" The Trainer pressed Nakayama 
Festa with the question.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Beneath the starry sky, Nakayama Festa and 
the others agonize. If they run now, will 
it end as just a "decent result"? Or—
